title: Correct receipt observations
purpose: Correct a mistyped receipt observation while preserving the original exact reading and prior values in audit history.
summary: Correct a mistyped receipt observation: temperature, thermometer, coolant, custody seal, preservation check or discrepancy.

tasks.title: Correct the cooler temperature
steps: Enter the reading exactly as read in [[Cooler temperature, as read]].
Give the [[Reason]] and select [[Correct receipt observations]].

tasks.title: Record a discrepancy found later
steps: Make sure the sample already has a disposition note. If not, use Change disposition first.
Describe it in [[Discrepancy]], give the [[Reason]] and save.

good_to_know: Once the sample is on an issued report, observations can no longer be corrected here.
Approved results may depend on these values. The page warns you, and affected screening or review must be repeated.
An earlier Hold or Reject can keep blocking work until it is reassessed.
The original reading and earlier values stay in the history.

sections.title: Correction sections
paragraphs: Custodians, project managers and administrators use these sections. A tab marked locked still opens to explain the blocker. The header identifies current client sample ID and client/project.

items.label: Identity, type, location
items.description: Correct client sample ID, sample type, sample source, collector, collection place and sample remarks.

items.label: Collection type and times
items.description: Correct grab/composite and its collection timestamps.

items.label: Receipt observations
items.description: Correct temperature, thermometer, coolant, custody seal, preservation observation or discrepancy.

items.label: Requested tests
items.description: Add tests or withdraw those with no dependent work.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Correct a wrong matrix and replace its requested tests together. A recorded sample source that does not belong to the new matrix is cleared.

items.label: Cooler temperature, as read
items.description: Required finite exact decimal, up to three places in a seven-digit field. Entered text is retained alongside the numeric value and must represent the same value; no universal acceptance threshold is imposed here. Entered in °C (the field's unit).

items.label: Thermometer
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters. Free text with suggestions: in-service thermometers from the equipment register, then instruments typed on earlier receipts.

items.label: Coolant on arrival
items.description: Optional list: Not recorded, Wet ice, Ice packs, Dry ice or None. Older samples may have none on file; it is required only on a new receipt.

items.label: Custody seal
items.description: Required list: Select…, Intact, Broken or damaged, No seal present or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe) whose text is stored, up to 160 characters. A value recorded earlier in other words appears as Other with its text.

items.label: Preservation check
items.description: Required list: Select…, Preservation verified at receipt, Preserved per labels, not verified, No chemical preservation required, Preserved by the laboratory at receipt, Preservation incorrect or missing, Not checked or Other…. Other… stores your own text, up to 200 characters. The lists are starter vocabularies, not method requirements.

items.label: Discrepancy
items.description: Optional corrected discrepancy. A nonblank discrepancy requires an existing disposition note; use Change disposition first when the note is missing.

sections.title: Eligibility and dependent work
paragraphs: Change at least one value. Any issued report snapshot containing the sample blocks this correction. Before issue, approved results can depend on these observations: the page warns with their count because a correction changes what the report will show. Repeat any affected screening/review; stale assessments remain in history and earlier Hold/Reject may continue blocking until reassessed. Change disposition is the separate workflow for the decision about a discrepancy.

sections.title: Saving and history
paragraphs: Physically disposed samples cannot be corrected. Saving rechecks the sample revision and eligibility. A stale form retains submitted input with an error; reload and review current receipt history before resubmitting.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required correction explanation, at most 4000 characters. It stays with actor, timestamp and old/new values.

items.label: Submit correction
items.description: Uses the page’s specific correction title. A successful save returns to the sample record. Earlier custody and issued report versions are never rewritten.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the sample without saving.

items.label: History
items.description: All receipt corrections for this sample, chronological, with reason and changed values. No corrections recorded is shown before the first correction.
